about: Renders a panel beside its trigger, with a title, a description and a close button.
only: Only rows matching all of these are shown.

placement.about: The panel on each side of the trigger, set by the machine's `positioning.placement`. The machine flips a panel that would cross the edge of the window to the opposite side.
placement.title: Placement

title: Popover

variant.about: Every look at every size. Press a trigger to open its panel. The size sets the panel's padding, the title and the description.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
